title: Add block reordering (up/down) with UI buttons, media preview fixes, and tests
body: ### Motivation - Provide a simple up/down reordering action for editor blocks so users can rearrange blocks and the session can persist an updated canonical positions ordering without changing block contracts. - Fix editor media preview reliability issues: image preview popups being falsely reported as blocked, blank-tab regressions when navigating to an object URL, audio play buttons remaining active during playback, and stale error feedback when switching audio tracks rapidly. ### Description - Add `reorderBlockByDelta` to `EditorDraftSession` to move a block by `-1` or `1`, normalize all `position` values to `0..n-1`, and call `touchDraft` after changes. - Update the block list rendering in `renderBlockList` to inject a `.block-item-actions` container with move-up and move-down icon buttons that are `disabled` at list boundaries and stop event propagation before invoking `session.reorderBlockByDelta` and `updateSummary`. - Adjust CSS in `server/editor/main.css` to support the new actions layout by adding `.block-item-actions`, `min-width: 0` to `.block-item-row`, and `flex-shrink: 0` to `.icon-btn` to ensure correct rendering. - Fix image preview popup false-blocked state by calling `window.open` before any async work so the call remains within the user-gesture context. - Fix image preview blank-tab regressions by navigating via `previewWindow.location.replace(objectUrl)` with a DOM-injection fallback (`createElement('img')`) for browsers that block direct navigation on a `noopener` handle. - Disable editor audio play buttons while a preview is active by introducing a `previewAudioPlayback` tracking object with `onStart`/`onEnded`/`onError`/`onInterrupted` lifecycle hooks and a `finalizePreviewAudio(reason)` helper. - Fix audio switch race condition by adding a `_previewPlayRequestId` counter so superseded `playAssetAudio` calls return early and do not emit stale error feedback. - Update viewer `getInputHelperText()` for `multiple_choice` to return single-select vs. multi-select guidance based on `responseConfig.selectionMode`. - Add unit test helpers `createSessionForTests` and `toBlockFieldsWithoutPosition` and introduce tests covering moving a middle block up/down, out-of-bounds no-op behavior, autosave/export/preview behavior, image preview popup handling, audio playback lifecycle, and audio switch race conditions. ### Testing - Ran the unit test suite including `reorderBlockByDelta moves middle block up/down and normalizes positions to 0..n-1`, `reorderBlockByDelta no-ops for out-of-bounds moves and preserves fields/selection`, `autosave/export/preview reorder paths remain position-driven without contract changes`, image preview and audio playback lifecycle tests, and all tests passed. - Existing normalization and response-config tests were also exercised and remained green. ------ Codex Task
